BiblicalUsage: Error is the word, and it works both against God and against a city. Isaiah says the vile person utters error against the Lord and empties the soul of the hungry, and Nehemiah says the enemies conspired to fight Jerusalem and to hinder it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two uses belong together: error against God and injury against His people are the same word, because the same heart speaks them.
